title: Little Hands Rainbow Craft Kit
summary: A bright craft kit for little ones: paper plates, rainbow tissue, cotton wool, glue and safety scissors.
description:
Everything for our [Paper Plate Rainbow](/tutorials/paper-plate-rainbow) and lots more rainbow makes.

- 6 paper plates
- 60 sheets of tissue paper in 6 colours
- Cotton wool balls
- Washable glue stick
- Child-safe round-ended scissors
- Illustrated instruction card

images.alt: Rainbow craft kit contents with tissue paper and paper plates
A child's finished paper plate rainbow

safetyNote: UKCA/CE marked toy craft kit. Warning: not suitable for children under 36 months due to small parts. Choking hazard. Adult supervision required.
